name: United We Row Youth Summer Rowing
description_short: Free youth rowing at the Watuppa Rowing Center in Fall River for students aged 12 and older in grades 6-12, sponsored by the United Way of Greater Fall River. Sessions run Monday to Friday, 8 am to 12 noon, and athletes can join any and as many sessions as they like.

source.title: Youth Summer Rowing | Watuppa Rowing Center

warnings: Session lengths conflict: the program is described as '2-week sessions', but Session 1 (June 28 - July 2) is only one week.
Confusing note: 'Session 1 may begin 1 week earlier on June 1st'. One week before June 28 would be June 21, not June 1, so this note may be left over from an earlier year.
The dates are listed without a year under 'United We Row 2027'. They were recorded as 2027, and the weekdays match (June 28, 2027 is a Monday).
The End of Summer celebration is on Friday, August 6, 2027, which falls in the middle of the August 2-13 session.
The copyright footer says 2025, so parts of the page may not be fully updated.
unknowns: Location: the street address, city, state and ZIP are not given (the page mentions Fall River, MA, but not the rowing site)
Registration link or method (the page only says to email the coaches)
Maximum age (only '12 and older' in grades 6-12)
Whether Session 1 starts on June 1 or June 28, 2027
Whether there is a session or holiday on Monday, July 5, 2027 (the observed Independence Day holiday)
Swimming ability requirements and water-safety rules
Refund or cancellation policy (sessions are free)
